title: 第003章 沉迷学习不可自拔第004章 学习是唯一能让他快乐的事
lines: 一周后，坚持每天学习10个时辰以上，苏恒就听到了系统提示音。
“叮，检测到宿主连续一周，沉迷学习不可自拔平均超10个时辰，特发放新手奖励，随机提升……”
“叮，辅灵学从0级精通提升到1级精通。”
轰~
一股庞大的知识从脑海中爆发，炸的苏恒脑壳疼，缓了几十分钟他才像快进一样接受海量知识，并渐渐消化，稳固盘横在脑海。
他再次震惊了，这些知识是真的，系统真可以在他完成任务后，发放海量的他还没接触掌握的知识！
以前的苏恒学习很用功，那是改变命运的唯一通道，他不刻苦也不行，但大一众多课程，就让他累的不轻，整天忙得厉害，现在七天就轻易得到了1级的辅灵学知识？这是一整个等级啊！
全国范围优秀大学生辛苦学习四年才能掌握的知识，他一周就得到了。
全国，不是一个学校！
震撼中，苏恒刚想继续梳理下新得到的海量知识，又一道系统提示音就响了起来。
“叮，身为一名学神，宿主除了要有真学神之心，同样要在考场、战场绽放自己的光芒，新手正式任务，战斗吧学神，请宿主在一周内，至少在战场上，血虐一名学霸，任务成功奖励1级术法木神术，任务失败，随机一项术法或学识、降低一个等级。”
新任务发布，苏恒脸色微变，这么快就有新任务，简直毫无停歇，而且这系统有些奇葩，完成正式任务提升一个等级、失败就掉一个等级？得了系统后若不努力，岂不是会被扣成文盲？想到这里苏恒就不寒而栗。
高材生若变成一个文盲，简直比死还可怕！
任务内容是血虐学霸？
什么是学霸？他理解中江州理工灵木系700多大一在校生，每次考核考试成绩都是全系前十，才算学霸吧？苏恒很努力，很用功，但全系排名基本50开外，分在自己的小班才是前十，准学霸一枚。
他还坐在桌位思考着，不远处一道倩影就走了过来，带着一丝羞涩开口，“苏恒，我能请教你一个问题么？”
等他抬头看到的是一个可爱女生，这是灵木系同学王媛媛，颜值70分身材凹凸有致，谈不上女神，也很有几分动人韵味，王媛媛算普通学生，成绩一般，全系排名300开外。
脑海闪过一串思绪，苏恒点头，王媛媛惊喜的坐在他对面拿出了自己的试卷。
“木生草种植在灰壤地界，以八十度气温为准，如何才能最快成熟，时限是多少？”
“学长，这道题很难，我已经求助好几人都得不到答案，你能不能帮帮我？”
王媛媛笑颜如花的俏脸上充满期待，还有紧张。
等她这话落地，几米外一张桌上另一男一女里，男生乐了，“王媛媛，你这不是难为苏恒么？拿这样的题问他，简直是折磨人。”
男生身侧的女生诧异了，“这道题很难？”
这个女生比王媛媛还漂亮一筹，有80分颜值，是系里很多人追求的小花，名字叫罗茜。那男生也是她的追求者之一，全系各种大小考核经常全系前二十名的存在，张宏。
为了在心上人面前争表现出风头，张宏嘴角一扬，看着苏恒的视线充满挑衅，“木生草是一种生命系疗伤灵植，需要充沛的木之力、水之力，这两种力量可以经过催化诞生出强大生命力，但木生草耐寒不耐高温、一个木生草就是一个考点，考的是灵植学基础知识，大二才涉猎的内容，你不止要知道名字，还要记住这种灵植的一切特性……”
“灰壤是一种特殊泥土，天生蕴含丰富澎湃的土之力，但特征是极度排水，考验的是土壤学知识要点，极度排斥一种微量元素硅分，很多灵植成长中，各式各样的微量元素是极度重要的，硅分却是木生草所需的必备元素。否则其即便生长，疗伤效果也会数倍十数倍暴跌！”
“八十度气温，不适宜普通水分存在，想要推算木生草最快成熟期，必须推算出足够的导水率，测定植物导水率的方法有压力室法、蒸发通量法、高雅流速仪等等，选择泞水可以不被灰壤排斥融入泥土，但计算导水率的话……泞水有低温，融入息壤的特性，还有微量元素浭，浭还能起到一定程度的替换硅分的作用，这是辅灵学知识要点，不管灰壤还是泞水，都蕴含数十种微量元素，你一个不小心，就会疏忽导致灵植不健康成长，不达标。”
content_en:
A week later, Su Heng heard the system prompt after insisting on studying for more than 10 hours every day.
"Ding, it has been detected that the host has been addicted to learning for a week in a row and has been unable to extricate himself for an average of more than 10 hours. Special novice rewards will be given out and will be randomly improved..."
"Ding, Auxiliary Spirituality has been upgraded from level 0 proficiency to level 1 proficiency."
Boom~
A huge amount of knowledge exploded from his mind, causing Su Heng's head to hurt. It took him dozens of minutes to slow down and absorb the vast amount of knowledge as if in fast forward, and gradually digested it until it became firmly entrenched in his mind.
He was shocked again. This knowledge was real. The system could really release a massive amount of knowledge that he had not yet mastered after he completed the task!
In the past, Su Heng studied very hard. It was the only way to change his destiny. He couldn't do it if he didn't work hard. But the many courses in his freshman year made him very tired and he was very busy all day long. Now he can easily obtain level 1 knowledge of assisting spirits in seven days? This is a whole level!
He acquired in one week the knowledge that outstanding college students across the country took four years of hard study to master.
The whole country is not one school!
In shock, Su Heng just wanted to continue sorting out the vast amount of newly acquired knowledge when another system prompt sounded.
"Ding, as a god of learning, in addition to having the heart of a true god of learning, the host must also shine in the examination room and the battlefield. The official task for novices, fight the god of learning. Ask the host to bloody torture a top academic within a week, at least on the battlefield. Successful mission will reward level 1 magic, wood and magic. Failure of the mission will result in a random magic or knowledge, which will be lowered by one level."
When a new mission was released, Su Heng's expression changed slightly. There was a new mission so quickly, and there was almost no pause. Moreover, the system was a bit weird. If you complete the official mission, you will gain one level, and if you fail, you will lose one level? If you don’t work hard after getting the system, won’t you be labeled as illiterate? Su Heng shuddered when he thought of this.
If a top student becomes illiterate, it will be worse than death!
The mission content is to brutally torture the top student?
What is a top student? He understands that among the more than 700 freshmen in the Lingmu Department of Jiangzhou University of Science and Technology, only those who score in the top ten in the department in every assessment are considered academic masters, right? Su Heng worked hard and studied very hard, but his ranking in the whole department was basically outside the 50th place. In his own small class, he was only in the top 10, and he was expected to be a top student.
He was still sitting at the table thinking, when a beautiful figure came over not far away and said with a hint of shyness, "Su Heng, can I ask you a question?"
When he looked up, he saw a cute girl. This was Wang Yuanyuan, a classmate from the Lingmu Department. She had a 70-point appearance and a curvy figure. She was not a goddess, but she was also very charming. Wang Yuanyuan was considered an ordinary student with average grades, ranking outside 300 in the entire department.
A series of thoughts flashed through his mind. Su Heng nodded. Wang Yuanyuan sat opposite him in surprise and took out her test paper.
"The wood grass is planted in the gray soil boundary. How can it mature the fastest and what is the time limit based on the temperature of 80 degrees?"
"Senior, this question is very difficult. I have asked several people for help but can't get the answer. Can you help me?"
Wang Yuanyuan's pretty face with a beautiful smile was full of expectation and nervousness.
When she said this, there was another man and a woman at a table a few meters away. The boy was happy, "Wang Yuanyuan, aren't you making things difficult for Su Heng? Asking him such a question is simply torture."
The girl next to the boy was surprised, "Is this question difficult?"
This girl is even prettier than Wang Yuanyuan, with an 80% appearance score. She is the beauty pursued by many people in the department. Her name is Luo Qian. That boy is also one of her suitors. Zhang Hong is often among the top twenty in the department in various assessments.
In order to compete for the limelight in front of his sweetheart, Zhang Hong raised the corner of his mouth and looked at Su Heng with a provocative gaze, "Mu Sheng Cao is a kind of life-system healing spiritual plant, which requires abundant power of wood and water. These two powers can be catalyzed to give birth to strong vitality, but Mu Sheng Cao can withstand cold but not high temperature. A single Mu Sheng Cao is a test point. The test is about the basic knowledge of spiritual plant science, which is only covered in the sophomore year. You not only need to know the name, but also remember all the characteristics of this spiritual plant..."
"Gray soil is a special kind of soil that is naturally rich in surging soil power, but it is characterized by extreme drainage. It tests the key points of soil science knowledge and is extremely resistant to silicon, a trace element. In the growth of many spiritual plants, various trace elements are extremely important, but silicon is an essential element required by wood grass. Otherwise, even if it grows, the healing effect will plummet several times or ten times!"
"The temperature of 80 degrees is not suitable for the existence of ordinary water. If you want to calculate the fastest maturity period of woodgrass, you must calculate sufficient hydraulic conductivity. Methods for measuring plant hydraulic conductivity include pressure chamber method, evaporation flux method, elegant flow meter, etc. Choosing muddy water can prevent it from being rejected by the gray soil and blending into the soil, but if you calculate the hydraulic conductivity ...The muddy water has the characteristics of being low-temperature and blending into the soil, and it also contains trace elements, which can also replace silicon to a certain extent. This is the key point of spiritual knowledge. Both gray soil and muddy water contain dozens of trace elements. If you are not careful, you will cause the spiritual plants to grow unhealthy and substandard. "
title_en: Chapter 003: Addicted to learning and unable to extricate himself Chapter 004: Learning is the only thing that can make him happy
